meta.name: excel-heredoc-fallback
meta.description: Create Excel files with openpyxl by falling back to shell-based Python heredoc when sandbox execution fails

copy.tagline: 用 Python 生成 Excel 文件，沙箱失败时自动切换备用方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在受限环境中可靠地创建 Excel 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create Excel files with Python, falling back when sandbox fails
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reliably create Excel files in restricted environments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会先用sandbox模式运行openpyxl代码创建Excel；若失败（如缺少依赖、权限不足），自动改用shell heredoc方式执行Python openpyxl代码，支持样式、公式等高级格式。
howto.when: 当sandbox执行openpyxl失败（如ImportError、权限错误、文件写入失败）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些数据做成Excel，带蓝色表头加粗。
say.note: 会用heredoc创建带样式的表格。

say.text: 如果sandbox出错，改用heredoc方式创建Excel。
say.note: 会尝试sandbox，失败后自动切换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first tries to create Excel using openpyxl via sandbox. If that fails (missing dependencies, permissions, etc.), it automatically falls back to executing openpyxl code via shell heredoc, supporting styles, formulas, and advanced formatting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when sandbox execution of openpyxl fails, e.g., ImportError, permission denied, or file write errors.

say_en.text: Turn this data into an Excel file with blue bold headers.
say_en.note: Will create a styled table via heredoc.

say_en.text: If sandbox fails, use heredoc to create the Excel.
say_en.note: Tries sandbox first, switches on failure.

say_en.text: Generate an Excel with openpyxl, including SUM formula.
